name: MVSEC — Multi Vehicle Stereo Event Camera Dataset
description: Pioneering multi-platform 3D perception and visual odometry dataset developed by the GRASP Laboratory at the University of Pennsylvania. Collected using time-synchronized stereo DAVIS event-based cameras (providing both asynchronous events and active pixel frames), Velodyne VLP-16 LiDAR, and RTK GPS/IMU across multiple vehicle platforms (car, hexacopter drone, motorcycle, and handheld rig). Captures high dynamic range driving and flight sequences in both indoor and outdoor environments.
